cli.usage:
Usage: lmps [options] <command> [args]

Options:
  --json          machine-readable JSON output
  --lang <lang>   language (zh-CN or en)
  --verbose       extra diagnostics on stderr
  --no-color      accepted for compatibility; output has no ANSI colors
  --timeout <ms>  per-stage timeout for apply (0 disables; default 30s)
  --help, -h      show this help

Commands:
  profile list|show|create|edit|clone|delete|import|export
  apply <id>  activate a profile transaction (--yes confirms switching)
  models      list discovered models
  current     show the active profile
  snapshot    capture a profile snapshot
  hardware    probe this machine
  lang        show or set the language
  doctor      run environment checks
  optimize <id>  recommend optimized candidates (--yes saves the head candidate)
  benchmark <id>  run a bounded benchmark for a profile (--yes stamps validation; 3 samples, 64-token cap by default)
  benchmark-all <id...>  run bounded benchmarks for several profiles in sequence (cancelable; --yes backfills each validation)
  hook status|token|rules|enable|disable  manage the local hook (rules, token, switch)
  proxy status|aliases|enable|disable  manage the virtual-model alias proxy (aliases, switch)
  --version   (not implemented)

desktop.help.title: Help and user guide
desktop.help.intro.heading: What this is
desktop.help.intro.body: LM Profile Switcher manages reproducible model profiles for LM Studio: it probes your hardware, estimates and measures resource usage, generates candidate configurations, and switches between profiles safely; a failed switch automatically rolls back to the previous profile. All data stays on this machine.
desktop.help.install.heading: Installation
desktop.help.install.step1: Requirements: Windows 10/11 (64-bit). The current beta has no macOS installer and the installer is unsigned.
desktop.help.install.step2: Download the LM-Profile-Switcher installer (a file named like LM-Profile-Switcher_0.2.x_x64-setup.exe) from GitHub Releases. The Gitee page mirrors source code only; use the GitHub download for the installer.
desktop.help.install.step3: Run the installer; it installs per user and needs no administrator rights. An unsigned beta may trigger the blue SmartScreen prompt: choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
desktop.help.install.step4: Prerequisite: install and start LM Studio. For online estimates or measurements, start its local developer server (127.0.0.1:1234 by default); if the server requires a token, set it in the LMPS_LM_TOKEN environment variable before launching this app.
desktop.help.usage.heading: How to use it
desktop.help.usage.step1: Hardware: open the Hardware tab to review the detected CPU, memory, GPU and VRAM.
desktop.help.usage.step2: Create a profile: on the Profiles tab click "New profile", then fill in the id, bilingual display names and model key; context length, GPU offload, temperature and behavior mode (exclusive or coexist) have safe defaults — adjust them once you are familiar with the tool.
desktop.help.usage.step3: Optimize: pick a baseline profile and preview candidates; each shows a score, field diff and bilingual rationale. Saving a candidate creates a new profile but never activates it automatically.
desktop.help.usage.step4: Benchmark: run a bounded real measurement on a profile to get decode/prefill rates, time to first token and VRAM usage.
desktop.help.usage.step5: Apply and rollback: click "Apply" on a profile card and confirm; activation runs as a transaction and automatically restores the previous profile on failure.
desktop.help.usage.step6: Command line: the lmps command is also available (profile list, optimize, benchmark, apply, etc.); human output is bilingual and --json emits a stable machine-readable envelope.
desktop.help.data.heading: Data and privacy
desktop.help.data.body: Everything runs locally: no telemetry, no cloud account, and the local service binds to 127.0.0.1 only, never the public network. Profiles and benchmark records live in the local configuration directory and can be deleted from the Profiles tab.
desktop.help.limits.heading: Known limitations
desktop.help.limits.body: The beta installer is unsigned; there is no macOS build yet; this is an unofficial, independent project that never reads or modifies LM Studio private data.
